content: Wayland GUI automation pattern (web consensus): ydotool (uinput via ydotoold daemon, socket at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/.ydotool_socket, present on target system v0.1.8) synthesizes keyboard/mouse input identically to physical devices on Wayland; AT-SPI2 over D-Bus (python3-gi + python3-atspi) reads the accessibility tree, text content of widgets (Text interface), and can grabFocus (Component interface) to activate a target window before each test case. Same combination used by production computer-use agents. Supports goswitch e2e harness design: focus via AT-SPI grabFocus, inject via ydotool, assert via AT-SPI Text.
